question: What are the gym opening hours?
answer: The gym at Block A level 2 is open daily from 6am to 10pm. Use your access card to enter; children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.
keywords: gym fitness opening hours time workout

question: When is the swimming pool open?
answer: The swimming pool is open daily from 7am to 9pm, except Mondays 7am to 1pm for cleaning. No lifeguard is on duty; children under 12 must be supervised.
keywords: pool swimming swim opening hours time

question: How do I book a BBQ pit?
answer: BBQ pits are booked through the management office or the condo app, up to 30 days ahead. Each slot is 4 hours (11am-3pm or 5pm-9pm), with a $50 refundable deposit and a $20 booking fee.
keywords: bbq barbecue pit book booking reserve

question: How do I get my BBQ deposit back?
answer: The $50 BBQ deposit is refunded within 7 working days after staff inspect the pit. Cancellations at least 48 hours ahead get the booking fee back too; for bad weather, cancel through the office and the fee is waived.
keywords: bbq deposit refund cancel rain weather

question: How do I book the function room?
answer: The function room at Block C holds up to 40 guests. Book through the management office up to 60 days ahead; it costs $150 per 4-hour slot with a $300 refundable deposit. Music must stop by 10:30pm.
keywords: function room party event book hall

question: How do I book the tennis court?
answer: Tennis courts can be booked in 1-hour slots from 7am to 10pm through the condo app, up to 7 days ahead and at most 2 slots per unit per day. Booking is free.
keywords: tennis court book booking slot

question: What are the management office opening hours?
answer: The management office at Block A level 1 is open Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 12pm. It is closed on Sundays and public holidays.
keywords: management office opening hours time contact

question: How do I contact the management office?
answer: Email office@parkview-residences.example or visit the office at Block A level 1 during opening hours. For urgent building faults after hours, call the 24-hour security guardhouse.
keywords: contact phone email office reach

question: How do I replace a lost access card?
answer: Report a lost access card to the guardhouse so it can be deactivated, then apply for a replacement at the management office. A replacement costs $30 and is ready within 3 working days.
keywords: access card lost replace replacement fob key

question: Can I get an extra access card?
answer: Each unit can have up to 4 access cards. Additional cards cost $30 each and are issued by the management office to registered owners or tenants.
keywords: access card extra additional new

question: Where can my visitors park?
answer: Visitor lots are at basement 1 near the guardhouse. Visitors must register at the guardhouse; parking is free for the first 2 hours, then $2 per hour, up to a maximum of 12 hours.
keywords: visitor parking car guest park lot

question: How do I apply for season parking?
answer: Residents can apply for season parking at the management office with their vehicle log card. Each unit gets one lot at $80 a month; a second vehicle is $120 a month, subject to availability.
keywords: season parking car vehicle lot apply monthly

question: What are the renovation working hours?
answer: Renovation work is allowed Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm and Saturday 9am to 1pm. Noisy work such as hacking and drilling is limited to 9am-12pm and 2pm-5pm on weekdays. No work on Sundays or public holidays.
keywords: renovation work hours noise drilling hacking contractor

question: How do I apply for renovation?
answer: Submit the renovation application form, your contractor's details and a $1000 refundable deposit to the management office at least 7 working days before work starts. Work can begin only after written approval.
keywords: renovation apply application permit deposit contractor approval

question: How do I book the lift for moving in or out?
answer: Book the service lift through the management office at least 3 working days ahead. Moving is allowed Monday to Saturday 9am to 6pm, with a $200 refundable deposit for lift protection.
keywords: moving move in out lift service furniture book

question: How do I dispose of bulky items like furniture?
answer: Bulky item collection is every Saturday morning. Register with the management office by Thursday 5pm and leave items at the bin centre beside Block D on Saturday by 8am. It is free for up to 3 items.
keywords: bulky items furniture dispose disposal throw rubbish sofa mattress

question: Where do I recycle?
answer: Blue recycling bins are at each block's ground floor lift lobby for paper, plastic, metal and glass. Rinse containers first. E-waste goes to the e-waste bin at the bin centre.
keywords: recycle recycling bin plastic paper ewaste

question: When can I use the rubbish chute?
answer: Rubbish chutes are on every floor. Bag and tie all rubbish, and don't throw bulky items, glass or liquids down the chute. Chutes are cleaned daily at 9am.
keywords: rubbish chute trash garbage waste bag

question: What are the quiet hours?
answer: Quiet hours are 10:30pm to 7am daily. Please keep music, parties and other noise down during this time. Report persistent noise to security or through this bot.
keywords: quiet hours noise night music party

question: Are pets allowed?
answer: Cats and small dogs (up to 10kg) are allowed. Register your pet with the management office, keep dogs on a leash in common areas, and clean up after them. Pets are not allowed in the pool, gym or function room.
keywords: pet pets dog cat animal allowed

question: Where are parcels delivered?
answer: Parcels go to the smart parcel lockers at the Block A lobby; you'll receive a code by SMS. Large parcels that don't fit are kept at the guardhouse for up to 7 days.
keywords: parcel parcels delivery package locker courier

question: How do I pay the maintenance fees?
answer: Maintenance fees are billed quarterly. Pay by bank transfer, GIRO or cheque; details are on your invoice. Late payments after 30 days incur 1% interest per month.
keywords: maintenance fee fees pay payment invoice giro

question: How do I get a copy of my statement or receipt?
answer: Email the management office with your unit number to request a statement of account or receipt. Copies are sent within 3 working days.
keywords: statement receipt invoice copy account billing

question: Will there be a water or power shutdown?
answer: Planned water and power shutdowns are announced at least 7 days ahead on the lift lobby notice boards and in the condo app. For an unplanned outage, contact the guardhouse.
keywords: water power electricity outage shutdown disruption

question: Can I install or service my air-con on the ledge?
answer: Air-con servicing is allowed during renovation hours. Contractors must use proper safety harnesses on ledges, and new outdoor units must be placed in the designated ledge area only.
keywords: aircon air-con aircond servicing install ledge contractor

question: Is smoking allowed?
answer: Smoking is not allowed in any common area, including corridors, lift lobbies, the pool deck and the carpark. It is only allowed inside your own unit.
keywords: smoking smoke cigarette vape

question: Can I bring guests to the pool or gym?
answer: Each unit may bring up to 4 guests to the pool at a time, accompanied by a resident. Guests are not allowed in the gym.
keywords: guest guests friends pool gym bring visitor

question: Where can I collect keys or documents left for me?
answer: Keys and documents left for residents are kept at the guardhouse. Bring your access card or ID to collect them.
keywords: keys documents collect guardhouse left

question: When is the lift maintenance?
answer: Each lift has routine maintenance on the first Tuesday of the month from 10am to 12pm. Notices are posted in the lift lobby a week before.
keywords: lift elevator maintenance servicing schedule

question: Can I wash my car in the carpark?
answer: Car washing is only allowed at the designated wash bay at basement 2, lot B2-01, between 8am and 8pm.
keywords: car wash washing carpark bay
